**AND GATE USING TWO SWITCHES AND LED**

**Aim**

To construct and demonstrate an AND gate using two switches and an LED on a dot board.

**Components Required**

Dot board  
2 switches  
LED  
Battery  
Resistor  
Connecting wires

**Working**

Two switches are used as the inputs. The LED is the output.  
Both switches ON → LED ON  
Any one switch OFF → LED OFF

**Truth Table**

Switch1        Switch2        LED

OFF             OFF             ON  
OFF             ON               ON  
ON               OFF             ON  
ON               ON               OFF

**Result**

The AND gate was successfully constructed on the dot board using two switches and an LED, and its working was verified using the truth table.

![][image2]

**Conclusion**

We successfully completed the AND gate circuit using two switches and an LED on the dot board. We also learned how to do soldering, which was a new and useful experience for us. This activity helped us understand the practical working of an AND gate and improved our hands-on skills.
